command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$rootId='885c6fe5-5e2d-4101-9e61-ec1a862ce3da'
$tempRoot=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $env:TEMP 'ResonanceM17G1-20260928')).TrimEnd('\')
$source=Join-Path $tempRoot 'restore-media\Short.wav'
$psql=Join-Path (Get-Location).Path 'data\postgresql-17.11\pgsql\bin\psql.exe'
$raw=& $psql -X -A -t -w -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h 127.0.0.1 -p 55439 -U resonance -d resonance_m17_scale -c "SELECT canonical_path FROM library_roots WHERE id='$rootId'"
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not $raw) { throw 'Could not resolve the expected disposable journey root.' }
$rootPath=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath(([string]($raw | Select-Object -Last 1)).Trim()).TrimEnd('\')
if (-not $rootPath.StartsWith($tempRoot+'\',[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -or (Split-Path -Leaf $rootPath) -ne 'library') { throw 'Refusing to write a fixture outside the expected disposable journey root.' }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $source -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Saved Short fixture is unavailable.' }
$destination=Join-Path $rootPath 'Short.wav'
$before=Test-Path -LiteralPath $destination -PathType Leaf
if (-not $before) { Copy-Item -LiteralPath $source -Destination $destination }
$sourceHash=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $source -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
$destHash=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $destination -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
if ($sourceHash -ne $destHash) { throw 'Restored fixture hash differs from saved G4 copy.' }
[ordered]@{root_id=$rootId;short_existed_before=$before;short_exists_after=(Test-Path -LiteralPath $destination);sha256=$destHash;restored=$(-not $before)} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
